summary: Mails are easy to read on a phone and Active assignments opens fast on large tenants.

fixes.title: Mails read well on a phone
fixes.text: Mails put the summary first, use no tables and give each item its own topic line, so they are easy to read on a phone.

fixes.title: Active assignments opens fast
fixes.text: The Active assignments page opens fast on a large tenant.

fixes.title: Least database rights for Community
fixes.text: Community installations can now use the least-privilege database model too.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Updates can be started at once, and status reports to Invardia carry more counts.
